top_stories.title: Housing Protests Across Spain
top_stories.summary: Tens of thousands of demonstrators marched across Spain to voice deep anger over the ongoing housing crisis. The large-scale protests followed a decision by lawmakers to reject recent legislative relief measures.

top_stories.title: Escalating Infrastructure Strikes in Kyiv
top_stories.summary: Russian military forces launched fresh attacks targeting critical infrastructure in Ukraine's capital, including a major bridge and logistics hubs. German politician Friedrich Merz visited Kyiv as officials warned of an exceptionally difficult winter ahead.
